changes.evidence: The stage has no #N, so it starts at S7#1, but Sibyl first appears in S7#3, first faces Daisy (as a projection telling her S.H.I.E.L.D. is destroyed and they have lost) in S7#12 'The End Is at Hand', and Daisy's quake destroys the Chronicom ships, killing Sibyl, in the finale S7#13 'What We're Fighting For'. The text and both card lines give away the series finale from S7#1.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
now.text: In 1931, Sibyl's Chronicom Hunters try to kill Freddy, and S.H.I.E.L.D. saves him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The Chronicom whose Hunters try to kill Freddy.

changes.evidence: Sibyl is not seen or named until S7#3 'Alien Commies from the Future!', where Luke and Abel meet their predictor Sibyl and argue over letting S.H.I.E.L.D. (and Freddy) live after their 1931 attempt on Freddy failed. A stage starting at S7#1 names her two episodes before she is introduced; the text works as is from S7#3.

now.title: Marvel Zombies#1
now.text: Riri is caught in the zombie Captain Marvel's attack on her group, where she is bitten and stays behind to cover Kamala.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A zombie whose attack costs Riri her life.

proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A zombie whose attack leaves Riri bitten.

changes.evidence: Riri does not die in Captain Marvel's attack in Episode 1: she is bitten but holds off the infection with her own serum, and in Episode 4 the real Riri hacks into Wanda's remade world to warn Kamala it is not real. Fandom lists her status as alive. 'Costs Riri her life' is false.

Blade's last stand and death against Wanda's horde in Paris is Episode 4. The stage has no #N (starts at Episode 1) and its text and card line tell both.

changes.evidence: Kamala's nightmares of the red figure start in Episode 1 (Blade names it as Wanda's doing in Episode 2). Wanda's healer act at New Asgard, the tainted feast and 'I need Kamala herself' are Episode 3. Taking the Infinity Energy, Kamala giving in, the remade world and Riri's warning that it is fake are the finale, Episode 4. The stage has no #N (starts at Episode 1) and tells all of it.
